<SuccessModal
				openState={success.openState}
				title="Karyawan berhasil dihapus"
				description="Akun karyawan sudah dihapus."
				onClose={() => {
					if (!mounted.current || !deleted.current || acknowledged.current)
						return;
					acknowledged.current = true;
					success.close();
					onDeleted?.();
				}}
			/>
